summary: The source is an SRS for Project Aegis v2.0, a web-based credit card management system with a browser portal (React SPA) and a REST API (/v2). It specifies authentication/session behavior (OAuth 2.0 PKCE, JWT + refresh rotation, rate limits), a 3-step credit application flow with a session_token gate and localStorage autosave, transaction initiation and history APIs including a foreign fee formula, dashboard/card controls (freeze/unfreeze, lost/stolen, PIN), billing/statement retrieval with multiple calculation rules, payments, and notification webhooks. It also defines multiple security/compliance and non-functional requirements including PCI-DSS/TLS, CSRF, audit trail, session timeout UX, latency, scalability, and PAN masking.

workflows.name: Platform endpoints & API versioning surface
workflows.description: Validate the published base URLs for portal/API and v2 versioning expectations as consumed by browser clients.
workflows.rationale: Multiple published entry points (portal + API base + /v2) and OpenAPI compliance note; small but foundational coverage for routing/compatibility.

workflows.name: WebSocket live transaction feed
workflows.description: Validate connectivity and basic client behavior against the documented WebSocket endpoint for live transaction feed.
workflows.rationale: Single endpoint with real-time feed implication; needs smoke + negative connectivity/auth/environment validation.

workflows.name: Auth session storage policy (cookies vs localStorage)
workflows.description: Verify that portal authentication tokens are stored in HttpOnly/Secure cookies and are never stored in localStorage.
workflows.rationale: Explicit storage prohibition and BFSI security criticality; requires browser-observable checks and regression guardrails.

workflows.name: User Registration (POST /v2/auth/register)
workflows.description: Create portal users with required validation rules and error handling including email uniqueness and password complexity outcomes.
workflows.rationale: 8 field-level validation constraints + 4 response codes (201/400/409/422) + email verification trigger; warrants broad BVA/negative coverage.

workflows.name: Login, rate limiting, and account lockout (POST /v2/auth/login)
workflows.description: Authenticate credentials and validate MFA optionality, device_id/remember_me handling, lockout after failed attempts, and per-IP rate limiting responses.
workflows.rationale: Multiple outcome matrix branches (200/401/403/429) plus conditional MFA and remember_me TTL behavior and lockout threshold (5 attempts) and rate limit (10 req/min/IP).

workflows.name: Token refresh rotation (POST /v2/auth/token/refresh)
workflows.description: Issue new access tokens via single-use refresh tokens and verify old refresh invalidation and TOKEN_INVALID behavior.
workflows.rationale: Security-critical rotation + single-use constraint with explicit 200/401 outcomes; needs reuse/expiry/parallel refresh test points.

workflows.name: Credit application flow orchestration (3 sequential steps + session_token + ordering)
workflows.description: Validate the end-to-end multi-step application sequencing rules including session_token issuance and requirement across steps.
workflows.rationale: Multi-step dependency with artifacts (application_id, session_token), mandatory ordering, and gating across Steps 1–3; requires positive + out-of-order + missing token coverage.

workflows.name: Credit application draft autosave to localStorage (every 60 seconds)
workflows.description: Verify the browser portal auto-saves application drafts to localStorage at the specified interval.
workflows.rationale: Explicit timing + storage location requirement; requires timing accuracy and persistence checks without conflating with auth localStorage prohibition.

workflows.name: Credit Application Step 1 Personal Information (POST /v2/applications/start)
workflows.description: Initiate applications and validate field constraints, duplicate application handling, and return of application_id/session_token.
workflows.rationale: Multiple validations (name/email match/E.164/address fields/province/postal/id enum/id_number) plus 201/400/409 outcomes; needs BVA and negative coverage.

workflows.name: Credit Application Step 2 Financial Information (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/financials)
workflows.description: Submit financials with X-App-Session header, validate conditional employer_name, consent gate, queued credit pull status response, and session expiry behavior.
workflows.rationale: Header-gated token with 30 min expiry + conditional field requirement + numeric constraints + consent boolean + 200/400/401 outcomes and returned status PENDING_REVIEW/fico_pull_id.

workflows.name: Credit Application Step 3 Decision & Card Selection (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/submit)
workflows.description: Finalize applications, validate signature requirement, card_product_id requirement, and all decision branches by FICO thresholds.
workflows.rationale: Outcome matrix with 3 distinct 200 responses (APPROVED/PENDING/DECLINED) + 400 SIGNATURE_REQUIRED; requires boundary testing around 600/680 thresholds and response payload verification.

workflows.name: Initiate web-initiated transaction (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Authorize and post transactions with ownership enforcement, amount/merchant/mcc/currency/exchange validations, and all documented ISO-8583-derived outcomes.
workflows.rationale: Large validation surface + multiple response outcomes (200 approved, 200 over-limit flag, 402, 403, 422, 429) + conditional exchange_rate when currency_code != CAD + frequency limit branch.

workflows.name: List transactions with pagination and filters (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Retrieve transaction history with pagination defaults/limits, date filter rules, category filter enum, and forbidden access handling.
workflows.rationale: Pagination boundary rules (page min 1, per_page max 100) + date ordering constraint with 400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE + 403 FORBIDDEN + filter enum correctness.

workflows.name: Foreign transaction fee calculation (REQ-006)
workflows.description: Validate the foreign exchange total calculation and separate foreign_fee_amount itemization when currency_code is not CAD.
workflows.rationale: Explicit numeric formula Total_CAD = (transaction_amount × exchange_rate) × 1.03 plus itemization requirement; needs golden value + rounding/tolerance-style checks and boundary around CAD vs non-CAD.

workflows.name: Get account summary (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/summary)
workflows.description: Retrieve balances/credit/account status and validate include_rewards default and owner-only access.
workflows.rationale: Core dashboard endpoint with access control (403) and query param default behavior; validates key financial fields presence.

workflows.name: Freeze / unfreeze card status with OTP (PATCH /v2/cards/{card_id}/status)
workflows.description: Change card status between Active and Frozen with OTP confirmation, validate reason length and audit logging requirement, and invalid transition handling.
workflows.rationale: State transition constraints (only {Active, Frozen}) + OTP failure branch (401) + invalid transition branch (400 with allowed_transitions) + audit trail note for reason.

workflows.name: Report card lost/stolen (POST /v2/cards/{card_id}/report-lost)
workflows.description: Block card and trigger replacement workflow, ensure irreversibility and prevent repeat report when already blocked/closed.
workflows.rationale: Irreversible action + two loss_type branches + optional fields + 200/409 outcomes; needs state-based negative coverage.

workflows.name: Set/reset virtual PIN with OTP and encryption (PUT /v2/cards/{card_id}/pin)
workflows.description: Set/reset card PIN validating format/match, session_otp requirement, blocked-card restriction, and client encryption expectation (RSA-OAEP).
workflows.rationale: Multiple validation branches (200/400 PIN_MISMATCH or PIN_FORMAT/403 CARD_BLOCKED) plus transport/encryption requirement and dependency on OTP endpoint reference.

workflows.name: Statement retrieval (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/statements/{statement_id})
workflows.description: Retrieve billing statements in JSON/PDF formats and validate 404 behavior when not found/not generated.
workflows.rationale: Format enum + default + required response keys + 404 NOT_FOUND branch; foundational for downstream billing validation.

workflows.name: Interest calculation (REQ-009 ADB method)
workflows.description: Verify interest computation aligns with ADB/APR/days formula across representative cycles and boundary values.
workflows.rationale: Independent numeric rule with multiple inputs; requires golden-value and boundary/precision checks.

workflows.name: Grace period logic (REQ-010)
workflows.description: Verify 21-day grace period is applied only when prev_statement_balance_paid_in_full is true.
workflows.rationale: Binary decision rule that gates billing behavior; needs both branches validated.

workflows.name: Late fee trigger boundary (REQ-011)
workflows.description: Verify late_fee = $35.00 triggers only when payment_received_date is strictly greater than due_date + 2 days.
workflows.rationale: Time boundary rule with strict inequality and fixed fee value; requires at-boundary and just-over boundary checks.

workflows.name: Rewards accrual and rounding (REQ-012, REQ-013)
workflows.description: Verify Travel MCC multiplier vs non-travel and enforce floor-only rounding behavior.
workflows.rationale: Two coupled numeric rules: multiplier by category and rounding policy; requires fractional amounts and category variation coverage.

workflows.name: Statement accuracy tolerance (REQ-015)
workflows.description: Validate total_spend equals sum(transaction_amount[]) within ±$0.01 tolerance.
workflows.rationale: Independent numeric reconciliation rule with explicit tolerance; requires within-tolerance and out-of-tolerance validations.

workflows.name: Make a payment (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/payments)
workflows.description: Submit immediate or scheduled payments validating min/max, type enum, linked bank account requirement, and error outcomes.
workflows.rationale: Multiple constraints (min $1.00, max total_balance, scheduled future date, required bank_account_id pre-linked) + outcomes (200/400 BELOW_MINIMUM/422 INVALID_BANK_ACCOUNT).

workflows.name: PAN masking requirement (REQ-014)
workflows.description: Ensure PAN is displayed masked in browser and full PAN is never transmitted to frontend.
workflows.rationale: Direct PCI/PII exposure risk; requires UI/network payload inspection and regression coverage.

workflows.name: Right to rescind (REQ-016) (DELETE /v2/accounts/{{id}})
workflows.description: Verify account rescission is allowed within 14 days post-issuance with no membership fee and rejected after Day 14.
workflows.rationale: Time-window compliance rule with acceptance/rejection behavior; needs boundary around day 14 and post-window rejection.

workflows.name: PCI-DSS transport and tokenisation (NFR-01)
workflows.description: Validate TLS 1.3 usage and that card fields use iframe tokenisation with no raw PAN in the DOM.
workflows.rationale: Explicit PCI-DSS L1 requirement with concrete implementation constraints; needs browser DOM and network-level assertions.

workflows.name: CSRF protection and SameSite cookie policy (NFR-05)
workflows.description: Verify X-CSRF-Token is required on state-changing endpoints and SameSite=Strict cookie policy is enforced.
workflows.rationale: Cross-cutting security control affecting all mutating operations; requires positive/negative token tests and cookie attribute validation.

workflows.name: Session timeout warning modal and auto-logout (NFR-06)
workflows.description: Validate portal session expires after 15 minutes inactivity with a 2-minute warning modal before logout.
workflows.rationale: Explicit UX+security timing requirements; needs timing accuracy and post-timeout access behavior checks.

workflows.name: Audit trail for credit_limit changes (NFR-04)
workflows.description: Verify that any credit_limit change produces an immutable audit log entry with required fields.
workflows.rationale: Compliance/audit requirement with mandatory fields (user_id, session_id, ip_address, timestamp_utc); needs at least create + verify immutability/field completeness.

workflows.name: API latency threshold (NFR-02)
workflows.description: Validate API p95 latency meets the ≤ 1,500 ms requirement under defined test load profiles.
workflows.rationale: Explicit performance SLO; requires baseline and stressed p95 measurement to detect regressions.

workflows.name: Web portal Time-to-Interactive threshold (NFR-02)
workflows.description: Validate portal TTI is ≤ 3 seconds on 4G conditions.
workflows.rationale: Explicit frontend performance target; requires controlled network simulation and measurement.

workflows.name: API gateway scalability & autoscaling trigger (NFR-03)
workflows.description: Validate gateway sustains 5,000 concurrent req/sec and autoscaling triggers at 70% CPU utilization.
workflows.rationale: Two distinct scale requirements (throughput + autoscaling trigger) in high-risk payments/credit context; requires load test and infra observability checks.

workflows.name: Notification & alert webhook delivery and idempotency (POST /v2/notifications/webhook)
workflows.description: Validate alert payload validations, supported enums, idempotency_key duplicate suppression, and response payload keys.
workflows.rationale: Multiple required fields and enums + max length rule + idempotency concurrency/duplication behavior + outcomes (200/400/409).
